statements.impact_statement: The vulnerable code is in golang.org/x/text/unicode/norm. The agent reaches golang.org/x/text only through github.com/santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema/v6, which imports x/text/language and x/text/message; unicode/norm is not compiled into the binary.

The flaw is os.Root.Mkdir and MkdirAll following an NTFS junction out of the root, which only happens on Windows. The agent image is published for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 only, where junctions do not exist and the Windows path handling (internal/syscall/windows.Mkdirat) is not compiled in.
